problem: Production i18n readback still expected the retired mobile select even after public language switching moved to deterministic locale links.
root_cause: The production verifier encoded an obsolete UI control shape, so a correct route-driven implementation could fail verification by timeout.
prevention: Production i18n readback must accept the canonical route-driven data-bg-language-option links.
Verifier keeps legacy select support only as a compatibility fallback.
NL→EN→NL proof remains same-route and checks html lang after navigation.
